## Projects

### manjaro-sway (Linux distribution)
Manjaro Linux with Wayland, Sway and a lot of love. 806 stars, 30 forks.
- Live: https://manjaro-sway.download
- Source: https://github.com/manjaro-sway/manjaro-sway

### museumsufer (multi-city culture monorepo)
Cloudflare Workers monorepo behind six public web apps for cultural programming. Five of them are multi-city verticals (museums, theater, concerts, lectures, cinema) served at `<city>.<apex>` subdomains; the bare apex 302-redirects to the nearest city by Cloudflare edge geolocation. landau.today covers a single city. Cities modeled so far are Frankfurt, Hamburg, Darmstadt and Heidelberg. An hourly GitHub Action runs the hub scrape, per-app derive steps regenerate typed bundles, and committing those to git triggers a Cloudflare redeploy. Nothing reads from a database on the hot path; D1 only takes request-time user writes. A backlog of city-expansion tickets maps every German city over 150k for staged rollout.
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/museumsufer

#### ins.museum
Daily exhibitions and events for ~40 Frankfurt Museumsufer museums, extending to Hamburg (Kunsthalle, Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe, Deichtorhallen, SHMH houses). 15+ deterministic scrapers (Tribe Events, TYPO3 calendarize, schema.org microdata, WP REST + ACF, RSS, Kirby CMS), DeepL EN/FR translation, image proxy, distance sorting via RMV, fuzzy search, PWA.
- Live: https://ins.museum (also https://museumsufer.app, an SEO-primary alias pinned to Frankfurt)

#### ins.theater
Hourly performance schedule across Frankfurt theaters (Schauspiel, Oper, Mousonturm, English Theatre, Komödie, Tigerpalast, the Reservix-fronted small houses, plus long-tail venues) alongside Hamburg houses. Editorial Programmheft styling.
- Live: https://ins.theater

#### konzert.haus
Classical, jazz, sacred, world, experimental and chamber concerts across Frankfurt and the Rhein-Main region. No pop, no rock.
- Live: https://konzert.haus

#### lichtspiel.haus
Daily cinema programme across arthouse + repertory cinemas: DFF, Astor, Cinéma/Eldorado/Harmonie, Pupille, Mal seh'n, Murnau, Caligari, Filmforum Höchst, Kinopolis. TMDb-enriched posters and synopses, Rotten Tomatoes + IMDb ratings, film-strip date slider in a Wiener-Werkstätte / Saul-Bass register.
- Live: https://lichtspiel.haus

#### lehr.salon
Daily index of public lectures, readings and discussions. Sources include the Polytechnische Gesellschaft, Haus am Dom, Jüdische Gemeinde, Literaturhaus, Bürgeruniversität, Sigmund-Freud-Institut, Denkbar and more. Cross-imports Vortrag-class events from the museums + theaters apps. Annotated-quarto identity.
- Live: https://lehr.salon

#### landau.today
Events for Landau in der Pfalz and the Südliche Weinstraße from six public sources, aggregated into a single SSR page with URL-bound category and date filters.
- Live: https://landau.today

### trinkhallen-app
Cloudflare Workers + Hono app for finding German Trinkhallen, Spätis and Wasserhäuschen.
- Live: https://trinkhallen.app
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/trinkhallen-app

### werk-review
Modern, fast database and review platform for classical literature. Curated authors and works of world literature, automated Wikipedia/AI enrichment, Project Gutenberg-DE + LibriVox links.
- Live: https://werk.review
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/werk-review

### wanderbar.fyi
GPX weather warnings as a PWA: one track, a pace-profile ETA, and a wake-up push that notifies only when conditions worsen or clear. All weather logic client-side.
- Live: https://wanderbar.fyi
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/wanderbar.fyi

### oritdidnthappen
Pics or it didn't happen. BYOS event photo sharing. Guests upload straight into the host's own Google Drive or Dropbox. No login, no servers storing your photos. HonoX + Cloudflare Workers + D1.
- Live: https://oritdidnthappen.pics
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/oritdidnthappen

### schnitzeljaeger.in
Baue teilbare, standortbasierte Schnitzeljagden mit Karte, Rätseln und geheimem Lösungswort. HonoX auf Cloudflare Workers.
- Live: https://schnitzeljaeger.in
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/schnitzeljaeger.in

### fetch-proxy
Lightweight HTTP proxy for fetching pages from servers that block datacenter IPs or have broken TLS, with optional FlareSolverr (Cloudflare challenge) and stealth-render fallbacks.
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/fetch-proxy

- Source: https://github.com/boredland/aufteilung

### saferound
Sum-safe rounding for number arrays.
- Source: https://github.com/boredland/saferound
